text_block_list.name: Titleholder
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Young Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"—My, that's amazing...! 
You're so strong, Titleholder."

text_block_list.name: Young Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Doesn't it hurt your fists 
to hit it that much?"

text_block_list.name: Young Titleholder
text_block_list.text:
"Not at all. 
I've already hit it hundreds of times."

text_block_list.name: Young Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Hundreds of times? Incredible...! 
Hey, can I give it a try too?"

text_block_list.name: Young Titleholder
text_block_list.text: "No. You'll hurt yourself."

text_block_list.name: Young Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: "I'll be fine! Because I—"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, Titleholder! Sorry about that. 
I borrowed your punching bag again."

text_block_list.name: Titleholder
text_block_list.text:
"...Your strikes are sharper than before. 
You've gotten... stronger."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Of course. After all... 
I'm a horsegirl born in Hidaka."

text_block_list.name: Titleholder
text_block_list.text: ...Then I am no different.

text_block_list.name: Titleholder
text_block_list.text:
"You had conviction. You had courage. 
You were always running... ahead of me."

text_block_list.name: Titleholder
text_block_list.text: Yet now—I've caught up.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
"Your exam results were excellent. 
There shouldn't be any issue running in 
upcoming races."

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
"Of course, we will continue monitoring 
your condition. 
That said... your run in the Victoria Mile 
hardly looked like someone coming off a 
long layoff."

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
"I imagine the sensation of running 
feels undeniably different now...?"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. Which is why... I made that change 
my own."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: All so that I can survive.

The Victoria Mile was a race for 
horsegirls on the Tiara route. 
However, today's Takarazuka Kinen is—
choice_data_list:
Where titans from across various routes 
gather.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Yes.

What Daring Tact seeks is a radiance 
surpassing even the Triple Tiara... 
Unless she keeps producing results, she 
cannot call this a true comeback.
choice_data_list:
Still, the competition this time is 
exceptionally fierce...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: ...Titleholder.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Titleholder is a formidable horsegirl. 
Like me, she bears strength honed by raw 
nature."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"In her quest to become 'the strongest,' 
she once climbed 
a whole mountain on handstands, didn't 
she...?"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Hehe, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Still, I will be fine. 
—I won't lose."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"The Takarazuka Kinen is 
a race where the dreams of the fans 
converge..."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"There is no better stage 
to repay all their support."
choice_data_list:
Yeah, show them the strength you possess 
right now!

Right, unleash everything you have right 
now!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Yes!

And besides Titleholder, 
there was another horsegirl on my mind—
(Clap, clap, clap, clap...!)

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
"All this attention... 
She truly is the daughter of a 
distinguished racing lineage."

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
"Efforia. Ever since meeting her 
at the party back then... 
I knew her aura was extraordinary."

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text: ...This lineup is truly formidable.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"...Win Marilyn? 
Are you all right?"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"It doesn't seem quite like your usual 
self... 
...You appear somewhat unsettled."

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
"...Goodness! I'm failing as an actress, 
aren't I? 
Though... it's hard not to feel shaken."

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
"A fierce wind is blowing toward a new 
era. 
If you don't cling tight—you'll be swept 
right away."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Win Marilyn—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"...!  
This thirst for blood—"

text_block_list.name: Titleholder
text_block_list.text:
"—Impressive. Without reflexes like that, 
we wouldn't survive on the mountains."

text_block_list.name: Titleholder
text_block_list.text:
"Your edge hasn't dulled in the slightest. 
Which means you're still 'the strongest.'"

text_block_list.name: Titleholder
text_block_list.text:
"One of the formidable titans 
I must defeat."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"...Titleholder. 
Thank you."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you for acknowledging my strength 
and believing in me..."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"I may not be running in the exact same 
way 
you always watched before. Even so—"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"The strength nature bestowed upon us back 
then... 
hasn't changed at all."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"You know, Titleholder, I'm truly 
thrilled. 
That after growing strong together in 
Erimo, 
we can battle on such a glorious stage!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Let's give it everything we have— 
and survive!"
